text.p: Trading company Hagemeyer NV said on Friday it was ending its textile activities.
"Hagemeyer will discontinue Borsumij Textiles, the last remaining textiles operation which became part of Hagemeyer with the acquisition of Koninklijke Borsumij Wehry last year," it said.
In February Hagemeyer said Borsumij Textiles would return to profits this year after chalking up losses of around 20 million guilders in both 1994 and 1995.
"At the time, Hagemeyer announced that the textiles activities lacked strategic fit and would be deconsolidated in anticipation of their divestment," it said.
Meanwhile EHCO KLM (professional clothing) and Van der Staal (men's fashion) have been sold earlier this year.
The effects of Hagemeyer's withdrawal from the textiles activities were fully provided last year and have no impact on Group results.
Borsumij Textiles had sales in excess of 300 million guilders. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000
